title: View-first knowledge storage with private memory fallback
hypothesis: An encoder can store edits on a shared Mirror value orbit as compact angles and allocate full private values only when a per-edit projection residual exceeds a development-selected threshold, preserving SERAC/GRACE output quality with fewer bytes than always-private memory; compare the same fallback policy using generic Cartesian coefficients.
physical_object: one shared 16D counterfactual value plane plus explicit keys/radii
mirror_coordinate: per-edit value angle; private full-value fallback flag/index for off-orbit edits
logical_multiplicity: 64 independently retrievable edit behaviors with adaptive shared/private allocation
controls: Mirror-only view with no private fallback
View-first Mirror with threshold-triggered private full-value entries
generic Cartesian shared-basis code with the same threshold/private fallback
oracle on-orbit labels as a fallback upper control

task.value_mix: 70% fixed-norm 2D-orbit values; 30% values with orthogonal off-orbit component alpha=0.35
task.keys_and_radii: random unit keys and explicit per-key radii sampled [0.87,0.93], identical across methods
task.fallback_rule: relative residual ||v - BB^T v||/||v|| > tau stores the entire value privately; otherwise store Mirror angle or Cartesian coefficients
task.query_audit: exact key, four paraphrases sigma .03 per edit, 256 unrelated random queries
metrics: on-scope output NRMSE and hit recall
actual payload bytes and fallback fraction at N=1/8/32/64

development.selection: choose largest tau meeting NRMSE <=1e-5 and recall>=99%; fixed tie rule favors largest tau for fewer false fallbacks

success_gate: Frozen tau must meet dev NRMSE/recall gate. Every fresh world at N64: adaptive Mirror recall>=99%, value NRMSE<=1e-5, false triggers<=1%, fallback fraction approximates off-orbit share, and actual bytes<=80% always-private. Compare generic adaptive basis at equal quality and oracle fallback.
failure_gate: No threshold satisfies dev gate, or fresh misses quality/retrieval/bytes; if generic adaptive coefficients match or beat Mirror bytes at equal quality, no Mirror-specific gain is claimed.
boundaries: Synthetic known mixture of aligned and off-orbit values, not natural factual editing.
Fallback stores full private output values, not residuals; all private state is charged.
SERAC/GRACE retrieval keys and radii remain explicit and unchanged.
